newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Winterthur expects higher payout for 1996.
newsitem.headline: Winterthur expects higher payout for 1996.

text.p: Winterthur Insurance Co's chairman and chief executive officer said a double-digit increase in 1996 profits would lead to an increase in the dividend similar to last year's rise.

"A double digit profit growth would suddenly have a positive effect on the dividend. This would mean a rise (in the dividend) similar to the previous year's," Winterthur chairman Peter Spaelti told Reuters.
Winterthur raised its dividend on 1995 results to 19 Swiss francs from 17 francs per share. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
